example.content:
const targetFolderUuid = await eda.dmt_Folder.createFolder('嘉立创示例_目标文件夹', teamUuid);
await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 1500));

const moved = await eda.dmt_Project.moveProjectToFolder(projectUuid, targetFolderUuid);
await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 1000));

const after = await eda.dmt_Project.getCurrentProjectInfo();
const folderChanged = after?.folderUuid === targetFolderUuid;

_source.title: 移动工程到文件夹
_source.example.text.0: 1. 记录当前工程的位置，作为移动后恢复的锚点
_source.example.text.1: 2. 创建目标文件夹，等待 1.5s 让工作区同步
_source.example.text.2: 3. 把当前工程移到目标文件夹下
_source.example.text.3: 4. 回读验证工程已落到目标文件夹
_source.example.text.4: 5. 恢复：移回原位置（原为根目录时传 undefined）
_source.params.folderUuid: 文件夹 UUID，只能为当前工程所在团队或个人下的文件夹，如若为 `undefined` 则移动到当前团队的根文件夹

title: Move a project to a folder
params.folderUuid: Folder UUID, which can only be a folder under the team or personal space where the current project is located. If it is `undefined`, it is moved to the root folder of the current team
